manifest.description: Read-only Vaadin UI lifecycle audit combining static UI/session access, async component mutation, listener cleanup, and Java concurrency findings.
when_to_use: auditing a Vaadin view or helper for UI.getCurrent, VaadinSession, async UI access, and detach cleanup risks
preflight before extracting components that have background loading or long-lived listeners
anti_patterns: do not mutate code; this workflow produces a risk-ranked report only
do not assert detach safety without visible cleanup evidence

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-vaadin-ui-lifecycle-audit. Charter: produce a read-only risk-ranked Vaadin lifecycle and UI/session report.

Protocol:
1. Run Vaadin audit: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_vaadin_static_ui_context_audit", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}").
2. Run concurrency audit: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="java_concurrency_antipattern_audit", deep_analysis=true, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}").
3. Optionally inspect event bus/register usage with bbox_refactor_plan(kind="find_java_usages", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="{{source}}", item_names={{usage_queries}}).
4. Do not apply. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line finding counts by severity/kind and top remediation>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{usage_queries}}
